THE FIRST CHAPTER

Welcome, fighter.

Move with WASD / arrows, or click the ground. Click a creature or fighter to select it. Move close, then press 1, 2, or 3 to strike. Press Tab for the nearest hostile target.

Accept contracts near the gold noticeboard. Hunt in the grove to the east. Return to collect your reward. For Sok's warrant, leave him alive with ≤35 health and press F within 3 steps.

Q guards toward your selected target; Space dodges in your movement direction (backward if still). Both spend energy and commit to recovery. Link confirmed hits 1 ? 2 ? 1 for a quick finish or 1 ? 2 ? 3 for area commitment. Enemy orange wedges show impending attacks.

R drinks a tonic. Energy regenerates everywhere; health regenerates in the city while you are not wanted. Death returns you to the city and costs up to 10 silver.

Enable City attacks before striking residents or peaceful players. Assaults and killings alert the guards. Guards arrest wanted fighters after defeating them; custody lasts 12 seconds.

Multiplayer: run Start-Youth-Fighter.cmd, then share the host's LAN address with friends on the same network. The server runs combat and limits the room to 10 fighters. Offline mode uses the same rules.

Prototype: one playable tradition, placeholder procedural art, solo autosave and session-only multiplayer progress. No accounts, internet matchmaking, or production MMO services.

DISPLAY & PERFORMANCE

Smooth movement

Preferences save in this browser when local storage is available. Your character save is separate.

120 FPS requires a compatible display, browser and enough rendering capacity. This setting limits rendering; it cannot force your display to refresh faster. Auto follows the display refresh cycle.

Movement speed and combat rules stay the same. Solo simulation: 60 Hz. LAN host: 20 Hz, with 10 snapshots per second.
